name: bounds2d
description: What leaves the screen: an entity that goes more than a margin past an edge of the screen is announced (an action) and/or destroyed. The platform a climber left behind, the bullet that missed, the enemy that escaped, the player who fell, the thing a runner left on its left. The edge of the screen is the one the camera sees; the module has no idea of what the entity is. Other modules ask it where an edge is through ge/mod/bounds2d/edge.hpp.

components.name: OutOfView
components.description: The entity is out of view when it is more than margin units outside the edge of the screen that side_x and side_y point to (0, 1: the bottom edge, as y grows downwards; 0, -1: the top; 1, 0: the right; -1, 0: the left; the axis with the bigger number counts). Then, once, the action is raised (none: nothing), and with despawn the entity is destroyed (without it, it stays; fired says it was announced). Needs a Position and a Camera.

systems.name: check
systems.description: Announces and/or destroys every OutOfView entity that is past its edge of the screen.
